exposure: premature rupture of membranes for more than 24 hours
cohort: 236 infants born at a regional hospital in Japan between 2018 and 2020 who underwent blood examination at least twice by the age of 3 days.
finding: Elevated CRP levels were observed in infants exposed to amniotic fluid turbidity at birth, indicating infection, but few received antibiotics, while infants born by cesarean section received antibiotics more frequently, even with lower CRP levels.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean section were more frequently administered antibiotics even with lower CRP levels, while infants exposed to amniotic fluid turbidity at birth had elevated CRP levels but fewer received antibiotics.
